definition: This dimension controls how much of a player's progress is retained after death, influencing the stakes and strategies involved in gameplay. Variations can range from complete loss of all progress to retaining certain elements like skills, items, or experience across runs.
exclusion_criteria: Complete loss of all progress upon death
Progression systems that do not permit any retention whatsoever
inclusion_criteria: Retaining character skills or abilities after death
Allowing players to keep certain items or currency for future runs
title: Progression Retention Variability
